scholarship_exists.quote: International Scientia Coursework Scholarship (PUCA1025) Offer 1: Full tuition fee scholarship paid directly towards tuition fees for the minimum duration of program
scholarship_exists.notes: Applied for through 'UNSW Scholarships for International Students Commencing Term 1, 2027' (PUCA1029), open 6 July 2026, closes AEST 11:59PM on 30 October 2026. Offer 1: full tuition for the minimum program duration; Offer 2: $20,000 per annum towards tuition. Eligibility: commencing full-time study in a UNSW undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program (excluding UNSW online and UNSW Canberra) in Term 1, 2027. Competitive; merit-based (selection details not read).
